name: business-insurance
description: Maps the business insurance a SaaS company needs by stage: Tech E&O, cyber liability, D&O, general liability, workers compensation, key person, and EPLI, with triggers, cost ranges, and how to shop for coverage. Use when an enterprise customer requires proof of insurance, before a fundraise or first hire, or when a founder asks what coverage they need. Triggers on: "business insurance", "startup insurance", "E&O insurance", "cyber insurance", "D&O insurance", "what insurance do I need".
